description: An oil-style painting of a dim, rainy room with a black grand piano, its lid open, beside a tall window showing brick chimneys and rooftops. Crumpled paper balls sit on the piano and scattered sheet music lies on the floor. At left, a wooden cabinet holds an acoustic horn gramophone with a record on it, and a gold gramophone-shaped trophy stands nearby. A wingback armchair and a steaming teacup sit by the window. No people are shown, and there is no visible frame or border.
reason: The piano, crumpled tissues, record and gold gramophone trophy match the scene, but the room (patterned wallpaper, wingback chair, horn gramophone) reads as early twentieth century rather than 2011. Needs a human look at whether the period feel is acceptable for a 2011 album card.
